query: Which team won Super Bowl LX?
answer: The Seattle Seahawks won Super Bowl LX. They beat the New England Patriots 29–13 on February 8, 2026, at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, which made them NFL champions for the 2025 season [1][2]. Running back Kenneth Walker III was named Super Bowl MVP [1]. It was Seattle's second Super Bowl title; the first came in Super Bowl XLVIII [2].
